question: When must an applicant provide a Use of a Representative form?

claims.text: The Use of a Representative form is requested when an applicant indicates they are using a representative or when a consultant completes an application on their behalf.
claims.quote: The document is requested only if the applicant indicates they are using a representative or if a consultant completes an application on behalf of the applicant through the consultant portal.

claims.text: The IMM 5476 form must be signed by the principal applicant and, if applicable, their spouse or common-law partner.
claims.quote: The [IMM 5476 form (PDF, 648.31 KB)](https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/migration/ircc/english/pdf/kits/forms/imm5476e.pdf) must be signed by the principal applicant and, if applicable, their spouse or common-law partner.

basis: The applicant provided form IMM 5476 (09-2023) E, appointing a paid representative from Vance Immigration Law Professional Corporation.
Section B is signed and dated 2024-02-15 by representative Marcus Vance, declaring CICC license ID R512398.
Section E is signed and dated 2024-02-15 by principal applicant Jane Doe.
The document uses a current form edition, contains all required signatures and accreditation details, and shows no document verification defects.
prose: The submitted Use of a Representative document (IMM 5476) is current, properly executed, and meets all program completeness requirements.
